angle: straight up the glass table leg
start_frame: Lens on the flagstones looking straight up a tall clear glass table leg: the leg running up the middle of the image, the glass tabletop overhead reading as a ceiling, ten-inch Alice turning at its foot in the near frame.
end_frame: The same frame held on the look: the tiny gold key glinting through the glass ceiling high above her, lit from the lamp row beyond — goal and obstacle in one unbroken set-up.
constraint_honoured: 'Goal and obstacle in one frame — the episode's thesis in a single set-up. Static.'
movement_note: One of the two rationed 24 mm shots in the episode, spent on this vertical axis. The near-to-far exaggeration is the whole image, so the camera must not travel along the axis and spend it.
